extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Show Greeting switch under Skin Settings, Home Screen, at the foot of the Around the Screen list, off by default. Switched on, the clock on Home reads Good morning, Good afternoon or Good evening by the hour in front of the time, with your profile name when Kodi has more than one profile. It goes with the clock, so Show Date and Time off hides it too, and with the main menu at the top and five or more tiles there is no room beside the clock, so the time shows alone there. Left off, the clock reads exactly as before. A new install starts with the background on Slideshow: Recently Watched rather than Off, and Recently Watched shows random library fanart until something has been watched. An existing setup keeps its own choice, Off included.
